title: The Long Regiment
author: Silas Almeida
blurb: Oscar Montrose, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
